Questions

Before you start

Is this medical advice?

No. The kit is educational content from hormonal health coaches. It doesn’t diagnose or treat anything and isn’t a replacement for your doctor.

How long does it take?

About 15 minutes a day for 7 days, and you keep access to go back any time.

What if my cycle is irregular?

The kit helps you notice your own patterns. If something worries you, it’s always worth checking in with your doctor.

Why only $27?

Because the first step should be easy. Start here, and if you want more support, there’s a way to work with us 1:1 afterwards.

Script 1 · “Nobody taught us this”

Hook (0 to 3s)

Eliza: “Most of us learned one thing about our cycle at school. The bleed.”

Body

Maya: “But there are four phases, and each one can change how you feel, what you crave and what your skin is doing. Once you can see the pattern, your month starts to make a lot more sense.”

CTA

Both: “We put it all into a 7-day kit. Short lessons, a workbook, a simple daily rhythm. It’s $27. Tap Learn more.”

Shot: the two of you side by side, talking to camera. On-screen text: “4 phases, not 1”. Caption ends with “Educational content, not medical advice.”

Script 2 · “The saved posts”

Hook (0 to 3s)

Maya: “If you’ve saved a hundred posts about hormones and still don’t know where to start, this is for you.”

Body

Eliza: “You don’t need more information. You need an order to do things in. Day one, learn the phases. Day two, start tracking. By day seven you have a routine that’s yours.”

CTA

Maya: “That’s the Cycle Rhythm Kit. Seven days, $27, start tonight. Tap Learn more.”

Shot: phone screen scrolling saved posts, then cut to the two of you. On-screen text: “Start here”.

Script 3 · “Four weeks, four seasons”

Hook (0 to 3s)

Eliza: “Think of your cycle like four seasons in one month.”

Body

Maya: “Winter is rest. Spring is fresh energy. Summer is your most social week. Autumn is when you slow down. When you plan your food, movement and rest around them, the month feels less like a fight.”

CTA

Both: “We’ll show you how in the Cycle Rhythm Kit. Seven days, $27. Tap Learn more.”

Shot: four quick cuts, one per “season”, outdoors at golden hour. On-screen text names each phase.
